messages:
jess: Heads-up — after merging autotuner 'spectrometer-v2' (kernel-pick + hyperparam update) yesterday we see a regression on INT4/FP8 picks for long seqs (1k-4k). ~7–12% latency uplift p50 on H100L, smaller on A100. Repro on sm92 and sm89 nodes. Logs below.

micah: Oof. Any traces? Which tunables changed?

jess: main changes: pick_alpha 0.3 -> 0.6, kv_slot_threshold 8 -> 12, batch_kick_ratio 0.15 -> 0.05. Autotuner now penalizes small kernels more aggressively. Profiling snippet (hot path):

```
# pick-telemetry (short)
arch: H100L sm92
model: redwood-1b-int4fp8
seqlen: 2048
kernel_pick: small_int4_fused -> fallback fp8_kernel
counts: {small_int4_fused: 1200, fp8_kernel: 900}
cpu_ms: 95.2
gpu_ms: 110.5  <-- 12% more than baseline 98.4
kv_warmup_ms: 34.1 (was 12.7)
```

raj: kv_warmup tripled? kv_slot_threshold increase would reduce reuse; sounds like we're hitting coldpath and rebuilding KV slots more often. pick_alpha increase favors larger kernels, but with batch_kick_ratio drop we aren't consolidating batches into those bigger picks.

sophia: Did autotune change per-arch profiles or was this a global knob? We should have separate pick_alpha per sm. Suggest quick canary: revert pick_alpha for H100L to 0.35 and set kv_slot_threshold to 10, then run a microbench across seqlen buckets.

perf-bot: [automated] 2350123458 - rolling metric: int4fp8-p50-h100l +9.6% vs baseline over 15m.

micah: Agree to canary revert. Jess can you push config 'spectrometer-v1.1-canary' to the H100L pool? Also capture more traces with KV_DEBUG_SLOT=1 and enable pickbench sampling for seqlen=1024/2048/4096.

jess: On it. Will roll back pick_alpha and kv_slot_threshold for canary, run 30m sweep of seqlen buckets [256,512,1024,2048,4096], and post traces. Also will add regression test in pickbench to assert no >5% uplift for each bucket.

raj: Also add a guard in autotuner: enforce batch_kick_ratio >= 0.1 (floor) otherwise we see batch fragmentation and more coldpath churn.

sophia: Longer term: add per-arch learning rates in the autotuner and a hysteresis window so picks don't flip-flop during low-sample periods. Also consider lowering the kv_slot_threshold delta when sequence-length variance is high.

jess: Plan: canary today, metrics check at +30m, if green promote. If not, full revert + deep sweep of pick_alpha x kv_slot_threshold x batch_kick_ratio across sm89/sm92/h100l. Will add unit tests in pickbench and a quick kv-slot simulator test. Will update thread with results. :thumbsup:
